# mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/python 镜像坑(2026-05)

## 坑 1:镜像里**没有 python `playwright` 模块**
官方镜像 `mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/python:v1.48.0-jammy` 体积 4 GB,但只预装:
- /ms-playwright/chromium-1140
- /ms-playwright/firefox-1465
- /ms-playwright/webkit-2083
- ffmpeg-1010

**没有 python `playwright` 包**(`pip list | grep playwright` 空)。直接 `python3 your_script.py` 会报 `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'playwright'`。

## 坑 2:`pip install playwright` 默认装最新版,跟 base 镜像浏览器版本错配
派生镜像里 `pip install playwright`(无版本号)会装最新 `playwright==1.60.0`,但 base 镜像里的浏览器是 1.48.0 配套(`chromium_headless_shell-1140`)。运行时报:

```
playwright._impl._errors.Error: BrowserType.launch: Executable doesn't exist at /ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1223/chrome-headless-shell-linux64/chrome-headless-shell
╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║ Looks like Playwright was just updated to 1.60.0.  ║
║ Please update docker image as well.                ║
║ -  current: ...python:v1.48.0-jammy                ║
║ - required: ...python:v1.60.0-jammy                ║
╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
```

## 修法:派生镜像 + pip pin 同版本
```dockerfile
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/python:v1.48.0-jammy
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple/ playwright==1.48.0
```

**国内源必须用** `-i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple/`(默认 PyPI 在国内慢且不稳)。

## 验证步骤
```bash
docker build -t egova-playwright:v1 -
docker run --rm egova-playwright:v1 python3 -c "
import playwright
from importlib.metadata import version
print('python:', version('playwright'))
"
docker run --rm egova-playwright:v1 ls /ms-playwright/  # 看浏览器目录
```

## 用法(挂宿主脚本进容器)
```bash
docker run --rm --network host \
    -v /root/qj-login.py:/login.py:ro \
    egova-playwright:v1 \
    python3 /login.py "<url>" "<user>" "<pass>"
```
注意挂载文件路径 `:/login.py:ro`,容器内调 `/login.py`(不是 `/root/qj-login.py`,容器没那个路径)。
